NAME: Sniffin
DORMANT: Whenever you Research you may discard one of the cards you look at.
ENERGIZED: Roar: Research the top 3 cards of an opponent's deck. If you find any characters, you may retire one of them.

NAME: Glymander
DORMANT: When you PASS, each friendly character captures 1🍬 from an opponent.
ENERGIZED: After a friendly character captures 🍬, ready that character. Roar: A friendly character captures 1🍬.

NAME: Frisklaw
DORMANT: After an opponent looks at one or more cards in their deck, gain 1🍬.
ENERGIZED: While Axalon is your active Guild, your opponents may not TAKE their stash. Roar: Place an enemy in its owner's stash.

NAME: Mugchomp
DORMANT: After you play an Asset, take another turn.
ENERGIZED: After you play a Food asset, ready it.  Roar: Use any player’s asset. If it is a Food asset, gain 1🍬.  (To use an asset, it must be ready. If it is discarded, it goes to the owner’s discard pile.)

NAME: Buzzrip
ENERGIZED: Your opponents' Nommsters cost +1 for each damaged friendly character. Roar: Deal 1💥 to a character.

NAME: Burrowork
DORMANT: After any player plays a Work action, that player gains 1🍬.
ENERGIZED: Roar: Gain 1🍬. Fetch a card from your discard pile and then PASS.

NAME: Bravalanche
DORMANT: The single player who controls the most powerful character refills their hand to +1 card when PASSING.
ENERGIZED: All Coronis characters have +1 power. Roar: Ready all Coronis characters. For the remainder of the round, they are Rowdy.

NAME: Glintzy
DORMANT: Each player cannot play more than 1 copy of the same card each round.
ENERGIZED: While Coronis is the most popular Guild, all players may only play Rare cards. Roar: Defeat the least powerful non-Coronis character (even your own).

NAME: Glittermaw
DORMANT: When you PASS, choose an opponent. Each friendly Coronis character captures 1🍬 from that opponent.
ENERGIZED: While this Nommster is ready you cannot feed it. Roar: Choose a friendly character. Remove each 🍬 from it and add it to this Nommster, then defeat that character.
Playtest notes: very fun, the e-cost could maybe go to 8. but the 4 on the front feels fair because the other side is so good and feels thematic. this is probably my favorite nommster so far.

NAME: Chromacorn
DORMANT: When you PASS, remove 1💥 from each character in play.
ENERGIZED: Roar: If you control a Geist, Mortal, Trinkette, Graven, Creature, and Rootling character, you win the game.

NAME: Parette
DORMANT: After you play a character that does not belong to your active Guild, that character captures 1🍬.
ENERGIZED: When a character you control would leave play without being defeated or retired, remove each 🍬 from that character and return it to the common supply. Roar: Return a friendly character to your hand.

NAME: Zoompuff
DORMANT: Once per round, as a turn option, you may draw a card.
ENERGIZED: Roar: Return any character to its owner's hand.

NAME: Zybyte
DORMANT: Once per round, as a turn option, you may update 1 card in your hand. (To update 1 card in your hand, discard 1 card then draw 1 card).
ENERGIZED: After you update a card in your hand, ready this Nommster. Roar: Deal 1💥 to an enemy character.

NAME: Slyjack
DORMANT: When you choose Ziotech as your active Guild you may retire a card from your discard pile.
ENERGIZED: This Nommster's cost is equal to the combined number of cards in your deck and discard pile. Roar: Retire a card from your discard pile. If you do, each opponent loses 1🍬.

NAME: Cullmantis
DORMANT: When you PASS, each player retires the top card of their deck.
ENERGIZED: Roar: Retire 2 cards in your disard pile. If those cards are different card types, gain 1🍬. (Card types are characters, actions, and assets.)
Playtest notes: feels great, simple, excellent one to throw in the base set.

NAME: Dreemie
DORMANT: When you choose Wildkind as your active Guild, place 1🍬 on a friendly character and 1🍬 on an enemy character.
ENERGIZED: Each character with 🍬 on it loses all combat modifiers. Roar: Place 1🍬 on an enemy character.

NAME: Glarewolf
DORMANT: While Wildkind is your active Guild, each enemy character gains Rowdy.

NAME: Palmer
DORMANT: When you choose as a turn option to DISCARD a card, if that card was a Wildkind card, play the top card of your deck.
ENERGIZED: Roar: Shuffle each card from your hand into your deck, then draw that many cards. Your opponents do the same.
